status: PROPOSED ONLY; NOT AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED
purpose: Resolve covariance semantics and verify functional reparameterization before any more training
training: None; reuse corrected-pilot candidate and matched checkpoints, frozen weights
neural_device: native MPS only; reject CPU fallback
stress_strata: two scenes per each of six physical shifts; horizon is a prefix factor, not a separately mislabeled scene stratum
evaluation: 32-step neural forecast once; score 8/16/32 prefixes, not independent episodes
conditions: Original uncertainty versus declared linear-kinematic innovation covariance; identical predicted means
primary_measurement: per-coordinate coverage and proper interval score; widths and velocity overcoverage reported
stop_conditions: covariance fixture or Monte Carlo validation fails
any nonfinite state, variance or interval
mean predictions change between uncertainty conditions
checkpoint/source/hash mismatch or sealed/final trajectory access
reparameterized matched predictions fail numerical equivalence
advance_conditions: Resolve variance-head semantics and covariance coupling; report coverage in each coordinate and interval score. No advancement to model training or full study merely because wider intervals cover more outcomes.
limits: Linear covariance ignores neural feedback Jacobian; compare it as a diagnostic approximation, not a calibrated world model. Any retraining with revised uncertainty semantics requires a separate fresh protocol. No old V3 or V3.1 sealed final test use.
equivalence_control: Construct a matched checkpoint by subtracting candidate neighbor weights from source weights in the first four relative-coordinate columns. Verify identical MPS predictions on a small batch; fail if they differ beyond1e-5.
statistics: Average seeds within scenes; paired bootstrap within each physical stratum while preserving mixture weights. Two scenes per stratum remain diagnostic, not sufficient for final population claims.
